rationale: The Agent Mode requirements identify supported AWS regions, Platform 10.1.x+, Model Runtime and optional admin enablement. The Cloud Connected setup section adds callback and certificate requirements. The install path and SAIA-9918 rule out 2.2.0–2.3.6 and the 2.1.1 fallback omits Agent Mode. 2.4.0 is described as planned. Runtime data-zone/global AWS routing and possible Azure OpenAI processing outside the platform boundary remain distinct from the base installation guide’s no-third-party statement. The assistant Cloud install table and About deployment descriptions give context only.

exclusions: No supported Cloud Connected 2.4.0 release or tenant availability is established.
